decisive_items: sustained a dog bite on her right thumb approximately one week before admission
Gram stain showed thin, fusiform gram-negative rods in two of four bottles
response.rationale: R3 uniquely pairs the dog bite history with blood culture gram-negative fusiform rods, directly matching Capnocytophaga canimorsus sepsis. R2 and R5 rely only on thrombocytopenia and petechiae, but the smear shows no schistocytes, arguing against TTP and DIC lacks confirmatory coagulopathy data. R6 is unsupported by any bleeding evidence.

rejected.why: Thrombocytopenia and petechiae are nonspecific; no schistocytes or coagulopathy labs support DIC.
Absence of schistocytes on smear contradicts TTP; no hemolysis or organ dysfunction.
Macrocytosis and low iron do not indicate gastrointestinal bleeding; no melena or hematemesis.
